reviews.text:
I decided to try this shade because it’s one of the colors Mingyu has used.

At first, the color didn’t seem very special, but once I applied it, it looked so natural and beautiful on my lips. It really exceeded my expectations!

Now I want to repurchase and try more shades from this collection.
reviews.zh:
我揀呢隻色係因為佢係 Mingyu 用過嘅其中一隻顏色。

開頭望落個色好似冇乜特別，但一搽上面就發現喺我塊嘴上面超自然又靚，完全超乎預期！

而家好想再回購，試下呢個系列其他色號。

reviews.text: i like the scent and formula, however the shade doesn't match the pictures. In the picture chai is supposed to be a warmer nudeish red swatch, however it is more of a nude that makes my lips look pale when swatched on. my shade is similar to the model picture so I am not sure why this is
reviews.zh: 我鍾意佢嘅香味同質感，不過顏色同相入面顯示嘅唔太夾。相入面 Chai 應該係較暖調帶紅嘅裸色試色，但實際係比較裸色嘅色，搽上嘴望落好蒼白。我揀嘅色其實同模特兒嗰張相比較似，所以唔知點解會變成咁。

reviews.text: From top to bottom: 1, amuse Seoul girl, 2, Hince raw grape, 3, tonymoly grape syrup, 4, Clio fresh apple, 5, Colorgram plum bomb, 6, Colorgram satisfied fig, 7, Laneige blueberry jelly, and 8, Romand bare grape. Personally, I am very concerned with the tastes/ smells of my lip tints so I’ll use s for smell and t for taste when it gets in your mouth. 1, s peaches, t alcohol, 2, s peaches, t peaches + chemicals, 3, s vanilla, t vanilla + peaches, 4, s apples, t apple + chemical, 5, s peaches, t peaches + chemical, 6 same as 5, 7, s blueberry, t same, 8, s artificial grape, t disgustingly strong chemicals.
reviews.zh: 由上到下：1, amuse Seoul girl, 2, Hince raw grape, 3, tonymoly grape syrup, 4, Clio fresh apple, 5, Colorgram plum bomb, 6, Colorgram satisfied fig, 7, Laneige blueberry jelly，同 8, Romand bare grape。我自己對唇釉嘅味道同氣味好敏感，所以會用 s 代表氣味、t 代表入到口嘅味道嚟記。1, s 蜜桃，t 酒精，2, s 蜜桃，t 蜜桃 + 化學味，3, s 雲呢嗱，t 雲呢嗱 + 蜜桃，4, s 蘋果，t 蘋果 + 化學味，5, s 蜜桃，t 蜜桃 + 化學味，6 同 5 一樣，7, s 藍莓，t 一樣，8, s 假葡萄，t 化學味勁到噁心。

reviews.text: Got this bc of sunghoon, lol. But it is very moisturizing and the applicator is the best one ive ever tried. So cooling and feels so nice on the lips. Like cloud. Tint well but the color can oxidized. Chai ended up being more reddish than i expected (almost like romand almond rose)
reviews.zh: 買呢隻係因為 sunghoon 啦，哈哈。不過真係超保濕，而且個 applicator 係我試過入面最好用嘅。搽上嘴好涼爽好舒服，似雲咁。上色都幾好，不過個顏色會氧化。Chai 最後變得比我預期紅（差唔多似 romand almond rose）。

reviews.text: Purchased because ENHYPEN Sunghoon is the current brand model. Love this color (top swatch). Looks darker on the swatch, but is the perfect amount of a nude pink. Felt more moisturizing than other lip tints I’ve tried. Leaves a nice, noticeable tint after the initial application is gone. The gloss is kind of minty! Has a plastic applicator instead of brush so it doesn’t remove the lip tint as much.
reviews.zh: 係因為 ENHYPEN 嘅 Sunghoon 做緊品牌模特兒先買嘅。好鍾意呢隻色（上圖試色）。試色望落深少少，但上嘴就剛剛好係裸粉調。比起其他唇釉，呢隻保濕好多。完妝一陣之後都仲會留到明顯嘅底色。唇釉有少少薄荷味！用咗塑膠頭而唔係掃頭，咁樣就唔會點抹走原本嘅唇色。

reviews.text: Purchased because ENHYPEN Sunghoon is the current brand model. Sunghoon’s personal pick (middle swatch). A berry color which I don’t usually go for. I think I’d rather use it to put in the middle of the lips instead of all over. Basically have the same thoughts as my previous review of the Rare color!
reviews.zh: 係因為 ENHYPEN 嘅 Sunghoon 做緊品牌模特兒先買嘅。Sunghoon 親自揀嘅色（中圖試色）。莓果色，我平時唔係好會揀。我諗我會比較鍾意用喺唇中間，唔係塗滿成嘴。同之前對 Rare 嗰隻嘅評價基本上一樣。

reviews.text: Bought bc I needed free shipping and my pookie sunghoon was advertising this tint — I do NOT regret! This leaves a beautiful glow on your lips without being uncomfortable and sticky. The color seems to stay without darkening, and doesn’t erase unless you eat/drinkn smth. I get why the instructions say not to smack your lips together—just wait 10 seconds and the formula will do the work. For my summer mute cool toned girlies who want a pop of color without it being insanely bright, this one’s the way to go!
reviews.zh: 買係因為要湊免運費，同埋 sunghoon 推介緊呢隻唇釉——零後悔！搽完之後嘴唇有種好靚嘅光澤，又唔會覺得唔舒服或者黐立立。顏色望落 keep 到又唔會變深，食嘢飲嘢先會甩到。我明白點解說明書叫人唔好兩邊嘴黐埋一齊——等 10 秒個配方就會自己 fit 返好。夏天鍾意冷調裸妝又想加少少顏色但又唔想太搶眼嘅姊妹，呢隻就啱晒！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
